lyrics_trans: [Dahyun & Tzuyu - Party's already over? I was having so much fun! I had a great time tonight as well! - It was the best day of my life ONCE said tonight's highlight was us. - Really? That feels great! I was thinking that ONCE was the highlight of the party tonight. - ONCE shines the brightest wherever Yeah! And ONCE makes everyone feel great. - To be honest, I measured I was a superstar on the stage tonight Same, I felt like I was performing on a stage filled with my fans. - Feel like magic, so alive tonight Me too, I felt electricity tonight. - I want to experience this feeling again I want to perform for more and more people. - Will you take one for us one day? title: The Feels Voice Memo 2: Momo & Mina
lyrics_trans: [Mina & Momo - We're finally here at the party! This place is so big and wonderful. - I'm so nervous, we have never been to a place like this... Yup, yup! - Let's go into the main hall. Wow, there are so many people here! Got me frozen Everyone looks so beautiful tonight. - Yeah, I get so shy whеn I go to parties In my eyes, you'rе the shiniest star here. Believe in yourself. - Thanks, you also got everyone's attention here 'Cause I got that supernatural attraction. - Then, shall we sway in the moonlight and dance in the dark with ONCE? I'll love it, where is ONCE? - Oh there, hey ONCE!

title: The Feels Voice Memo 3: Nayeon & Chaeyoung
lyrics_trans: [Nayeon & Chaeyoung - Chaeyoung, are you ready to go to the prom party? Yeah, I'm almost done! - I'm so excited! Me too! I want to be there right now! - Who do you think will be the prom queen? I guess ONCE? I love ONCE's style! - Yeah, I felt the same! Uh, I'm so curious... Huh, what is it? - Should I put my hair up or down for the prom tonight? I wonder what's on your mind Mmh, down! I like the way your hair sways every time you move, it looks magical. - I was thinking the same thing! I can feel a real connection between us In that case, can you pick out my dress? Should I wear the light purple one, or the white one? - The light purple dress gives me the feels for tonight Right! Are we on the same vibe tonight? - I know, right! Wait, I've got a call from ONCE Go on then! I'll go get changed while you answer the call. - Chaeyoung, ONCE is already at the party, we should get going! Got it! Let's have fun tonight!
